title: Removing Loose Impediments on the Green
question: On the putting green, which of these items can you remove without penalty when they are next to your ball?
explanation: On the green, you may remove leaves, twigs, and even sand or loose soil without penalty.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl carefully picking up a twig and leaves next to her ball on the putting green, with a small amount of sand also present.
imageAlt: Teen girl removing debris and sand from around her golf ball on the green.

issues: The posture and grip do not clearly indicate left-handedness; the boy is using his right hand to pick up the leaves, and the putter is leaning on his right side, which could be ambiguous.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure the boy's posture and grip clearly indicate left-handedness: position the putter on his left side, held or resting naturally in his left hand, to authentically show a left-handed golfer. Maintain all current scene and golfer details.
